Nina (AE): Partner asks for 7yr audit logs + HSM BYOK for POC. Need line items for quote.

Omar (Solutions): Separate SKUs: audit-retention billed per GB-month; cold/archival tier for >1y. HSM is one-time setup + monthly mgmt.

Jess (SalesOps): Ballpark numbers to use: archival retention $0.005/GB-month; HSM setup $10k one-time (can be capitalized), HSM mgmt $500/month, HIPAA add-on $2k/month.

Nina (AE): Customer wants setup waived or amortized over 12mo commit (~160k ARR). Any discount guidance?

Jess (SalesOps): For ~150-200k ARR we can amortize; consider 25-50% setup waiver with Deal Desk approval. >20% discount requires RevOps sign-off.

ComplianceBot: Note: EU/UK 7yr retention needs DPA amendment and lawful basis. HSM attestations available on request.

Omar (Solutions): Caveat: cold tier restores may have retrieval fees; long-term retention needs retention policy and legal review per country.

Nina (AE): I'll draft two quote options (setup upfront vs capitalized) and open Deal Desk for 50% waiver. Thanks.

[reaction] Jess (SalesOps): :white_check_mark:
